text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 116, January 01, 1948 ]
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 85, SO AS TO POSTPONE THE ORGANIZATION OF THE
MUNICIPALITY OF CALAMBA, PROVINCE OF OCCIDENTAL MISAMIS.
It appearing that the chief municipal officials of the municipality of Calamba, Province of Occidental
Misamis, created under Executive Order No. 85, dated September 3, 1947, have not been appointed and have
not qualified and, consequently, the corporate existence of the said municipality has not begun, I, MANUEL
ROXAS, President of the Philippines, do hereby postpone to February 1, 1948 the organization of said
municipality.
Done at the City 0f Manila , this 1st day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight,
and of the Independence of the Philippines , the second.
(Sgd.) MANUEL ROXAS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
Acting Chief of the Executive Office
